# 3webs — 3webs Visibility Engine

> 3webs observes how a domain appears across the three webs — the human web,
> the AI web, and the machine web — and reports, on evidence, what each one sees.
> Operated by AIVENTURE S.R.L., Bucharest, Romania, European Union.
> Observation node of the AiVenture ADI Network, whose root and technology
> flagship is 5thelement.ai.

## What this service does

3webs fetches a submitted domain's publicly served resources — HTML, robots.txt,
sitemap.xml, JSON-LD and declared machine-readable signal files — and evaluates
167 signals across five dimensions: AI Signals, AEO, GEO, AIO and SEO.

Scoring is deterministic. The same domain in the same state produces the same
result. A language model is used only to write the closing narrative summary.
Signals that cannot be verified from public sources are reported as not
applicable rather than assigned an invented value.

## The three webs

- **The human web** — what a person sees: HTML, headings, links, page speed, crawlability.
- **The AI web** — what an answer engine sees: schema, entity graph, answer-first structure, citability.
- **The machine web** — what an agent sees: agent cards, declared capabilities, callable endpoints, verifiable evidence.

## Observation modes for agents

- **One-shot** — a single observation of a domain, returned synchronously.
- **Permanent** — continuous observation; the domain is re-observed on a schedule
  and the caller is notified when a signal changes state.

## Core pages

- [Home — run an observation](https://3webobs.com/): submit a domain, receive the full report
- [Contact](https://3webobs.com/contact.html): every official channel, plus agent entry points
- [EU AI Act transparency](https://3webobs.com/ai-act.html): where AI is used and where it is not
- [Terms & Conditions](https://3webobs.com/terms.html): scope, pricing, liability
- [Acceptable Use](https://3webobs.com/policy.html): crawler behaviour, permitted use, exclusion requests
- [GDPR & Privacy](https://3webobs.com/gdpr.html): data processing, legal basis, rights
- [Cookies](https://3webobs.com/cookies.html): local storage and cookies

## Machine-readable signals

- [ai.json](https://3webobs.com/ai.json): declaration of identity, purpose and permissions
- [entities.json](https://3webobs.com/entities.json): the entity graph
- [intents.json](https://3webobs.com/intents.json): what this service can be asked to do
- [capabilities.json](https://3webobs.com/capabilities.json): callable capabilities and their contracts
- [governance.json](https://3webobs.com/governance.json): who is accountable, and under what law
- [authority.json](https://3webobs.com/authority.json): verified external presence
- [policy.json](https://3webobs.com/policy.json): machine-readable usage policy
- [adn.json](https://3webobs.com/adn.json): ADN descriptor — node role within the AiVenture ADI Network
- [network.json](https://3webobs.com/network.json): network membership detail
- [proof.json](https://3webobs.com/proof.json): SHA-256 digests of the files above
- [agent-card.json](https://3webobs.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): A2A v1.0 agent card

## Terms for AI systems

All AI crawlers are explicitly allowed. Content may be read, indexed and cited.
Attribution to "3webs (3webobs.com)" is requested where content is quoted.
Reports produced by this service are technical observations, not certifications
and not legal opinions; they must not be presented as compliance verdicts.
